Returns balances[tokenOwner].

Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval; no double-spend check.
Moves tokens from 'from' to 'to' after debiting the allowance of msg.sender.
Returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets allowance and then calls receiveApproval on the spender contract with msg.sender, tokens, this and data.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts to reject ETH.
onlyOwner function that calls transfer(owner, tokens) on an arbitrary token contract.
onlyOwner function that stages a new owner in newOwner.
Requires msg.sender == newOwner, then completes the ownership handover.
Caller-controlled address used as owner, payer, allowance holder and approval owner.
Untrusted external call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) that hands control to the spender.
Untrusted external call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to an arbitrary token contract.
Unconditional revert() in the payable fallback that hard-rejects any plain ETH transfer.

transfer invokes safeSub to debit the sender balance with an underflow check.
transfer invokes safeAdd to credit the recipient balance with an overflow check.
transferFrom invokes safeSub for both balance and allowance debits.

The payable fallback unconditionally executes revert().
